links.outcome: Strict Success Rate and safety reasoning of guideline-graph-grounded agent versus baseline LLMs
links.effect: Exceeds strongest proprietary LLM baseline by 53.73 points in Strict Success Rate and 14.63 points in OSRS, with no unsafe recommendations under the automated evaluator.
links.quote: On the European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, it exceeds the strongest proprietary LLM baseline by 53.73 points in Strict Success Rate and 14.63 points in overall safety reasoning score (OSRS), with no unsafe recommendations under the automated evaluator.

unlisted_practices: Patient-adaptive targeted questioning to elicit omitted safety-critical information
Risk-first multi-agent policy with a final medication plan verification step

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel multi-agent LLM framework (ATLAS) and benchmark (GeriMedBench) for medication safety review in older adults via benchmark tests and a clinician evaluation study.
